assignment.boundary_rule: Preserve source-specific names, offsets, vtable candidates, decompiler limits, and contradictions; do not convert name-only SDK associations, decompiler guesses, or campaign shorthand into runtime identity.
assignment.scope: World and planet archaeology: planets, star systems, orbital and celestial simulation, planet records, planet models, terrain, climate, geography, managers, services, consumers, ownership, serialization, and reconstruction seams.

confidence_scale.high: Direct layout/field evidence or repeated independent static corroboration.
confidence_scale.low: Name, cluster, or topology only; requires targeted follow-up.
confidence_scale.medium: SDK association plus static topology or a bounded decompiler body, with identity limitations.

conflict_policy.claim: Conflicting offsets, vtable counts, and names are retained as separate source records; no canonical merge is performed.

evidence_policy.claim: Decompiler output is evidence, not truth; SDK names are imported vocabulary; no MSVC RTTI is present.

labels.INFERRED: Reasoned identity or relationship from one source, names, topology, or noisy decompilation; not runtime truth.
labels.OBSERVED: Byte-level, disassembly, decompiler-body, or traced runtime mechanics; identity remains separate.
labels.SUPPORTED: Multiple consistent committed exports, SDK layout, or independent static sources; no contradiction is hidden.
labels.UNKNOWN: The supplied corpus does not establish the claim.

conflicts_and_unreconciled_layouts.claim: SDK field export places cPlanetRecord.mCivData at +0x15c and mTribeData at +0x170; the global campaign field summary labels +0x188 as mCivData and +0x1a0 as mTribeData. No merge is performed.

SDK field export places mAvailableStarterWorlds at +0xa0, mStarRecordGrid at +0xc8, mStarterStarRecords at +0xdc, mSavedGameStarRecords at +0xf0, and mPossibleStartLocations at +0x118; the global campaign summary places these names at 0x64, 0x94, 0xdc, 0xf0, and 0x118. The SDK export is not silently substituted for the campaign record.

SDK/function exports list Terrain::cTerrainSphereQuad::RenderAtmosphere at 0x00fb6ca0, while the RE notes record that this symbol exists but is not a function; the address is retained as an anchor, not a recovered callable body.

The committed cPlanetModel::ToSurface decompiler writes through fields that Ghidra displays as vtable pointers; those expressions are treated as noisy decompiler field typing, not as proof that vtable slots are mutable data.

The sim-space decomp-gap partition contains a cCommManager::CreateSpaceCommEvent anchor whose SDK CreateSpaceCommEvent/HandleSpaceCommAction identity and ABI are contested; no world-planet ownership is inferred from it.

The vtable atlas has two 40-slot Terrain candidates, 0x01490be8 and 0x01490c7c, both associated with cTerrainSphere::GetSimDataRTT; the SDK ITerrain layout names 74 slots through 0x128. Candidate scan length is not treated as a concrete class size.
